name: accordion
title: Accordion expand
description: A disclosure / accordion / collapsible section whose panel grows and shrinks in height when toggled, with the header chevron flipping between a downward "v" and an upward "^". Use for settings groups, FAQs, filter sections, "show more" details — any header + collapsible body.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the accordion transition"

name: avatar-group-hover
title: Avatar group hover
description: Hovering an item in a horizontal stack (avatar row, chip group, badge cluster, segmented button) should lift the hovered item, gently lift its neighbors with a power-falloff, then snap everything back with an overshoot spring on `mouseleave`. Direction-aware easing (clean ease-in on hover, bouncy ease-out on return) is what gives the group its springy, physical feel.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the avatar-group-hover transition"

name: banner-stacking
title: Banner stacking
description: Sonner-style banner / toast stacking. Each new banner rises in with the **toast** motion (rise + cross-blur + slight scale) while older banners push back — smaller, higher, dimmer — instead of leaving; the fourth arrival sends the oldest out. Hovering the stack fans it into a readable list.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the banner-stacking transition"

name: card-resize
title: Card resize
description: Tweening a container's width or height when its layout state changes (compact ↔ expanded card, collapsing panel, list row toggling extra detail). Pure CSS — no JS required beyond the class toggle that drives the size change.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the card-resize transition"

name: card-tilt
title: Card hover tilt
description: A card / tile / media surface that tilts in 3D toward the pointer while hovered, with a soft light "glare" tracking the cursor across it. Use for product cards, credit / membership cards, feature tiles, cover art — anything that should feel physical and reactive on hover. Pointer-only (skips touch) and flattens under reduced motion.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the card-tilt transition"

name: checkbox-check
title: Checkbox check
description: Checkboxes, to-do completion, multi-select rows — any boolean control where the checked state should feel earned. The box's background fills first, then the checkmark draws itself via stroke-dashoffset after a short delay; unchecking reverses quickly with no draw.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the checkbox-check transition"

name: error-state-shake
title: Error state shake
description: Form validation feedback — invalid email, wrong password, missing required field, mismatched confirmation. The input shakes left/right with overshoot, the border switches to error color, and a message reveals beneath. After a hold timer (long enough to read the message), border + message fade back to neutral. Optional: typing into the input cancels the auto-revert immediately.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the error-state-shake transition"

name: icon-swap
title: Icon swap
description: Cross-fading two icons in the same slot — hamburger ↔ close, sun ↔ moon, play ↔ pause, expand ↔ collapse. Both icons stay in the DOM stacked in the same grid cell.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the icon-swap transition"

name: input-clear-dissolve
title: Input clear with dissolve
description: Clearing a text field — search box, filter input, any field with a clear (×) button. The typed text flies down + blurs + fades while a soft per-word streak ignites under each word, and the placeholder falls in from above. Per-frame JS is required: the streak envelope and per-word gradient stack cannot be expressed as static @keyframes.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the input-clear-dissolve transition"

name: learn-more-hover
title: Learn more hover
description: "Learn more", "See all", "Continue" — inline links or buttons with a trailing chevron that should acknowledge hover. The chevron slides toward the text's reading direction while its two arms spread apart into a full arrow, then eases back on exit with a slightly faster out clock.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the learn-more-hover transition"

name: like-button
title: Like button
description: Like / favorite / heart buttons — anywhere a single tap flips a boolean and deserves a tiny celebration. The heart's stroke fills with color, the icon pops with an overshoot scale, and eight tiny particles sprinkle outward before fading.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the like-button transition"

name: matrix-loader
title: Matrix dot loader
description: Tiny inline loaders built from a 4×4 matrix of 2px dots. All four variants share one colour-pulse keyframe; a per-dot delay table gives each its motion character — a column scan, a randomized-looking twinkle, a perimeter orbit, a centre-out pulse. Rounded variants drop the four corner dots.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the matrix-loader transition"

name: menu-dropdown
title: Menu dropdown
description: Contextual menus, dropdowns, popovers — anything that opens from a trigger and should visually grow from that trigger's position. Origin-aware via `data-origin` (top-left, top-center, top-right, bottom-*).
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the menu-dropdown transition"

name: modal
title: Modal open / close
description: Modal dialogs and full-overlay surfaces that scale up from center. Use when the surface is conceptually "on top of" the page rather than anchored to a trigger.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the modal transition"

name: notification-badge
title: Notification badge
description: A small badge appearing on top of a trigger (bell, inbox, button). Slides in diagonally and pops the dot independently of the trigger so the trigger itself never moves.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the notification-badge transition"

name: number-pop-in
title: Number pop-in
description: Counters, prices, balances, or any number that updates and should re-enter from a direction with blur. Each character animates independently and the last two digits stagger so decimals feel alive without looking chaotic.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the number-pop-in transition"

name: page-side-by-side
title: Page side-by-side
description: Sliding between two full pages or screens that live side-by-side: list ↔ detail, step 1 ↔ step 2 in a wizard. Page 1 exits left, page 2 exits right.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the page-side-by-side transition"

name: panel-reveal
title: Panel reveal
description: A panel that slides into view inside an existing container — e.g. detail panel inside a card, expanding section. Combines a short translate, opacity, and a 2px cross-blur so a half-height travel still reads as a full open.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the panel-reveal transition"

name: plus-menu-morph
title: Plus to menu morph
description: A small circular trigger (a "+" FAB, a compose button, an add-action affordance) that **morphs into the menu / panel it opens** instead of popping a separate surface next to it. The button's box grows in width / height and relaxes its corner radius into a rounded panel while the plus icon cross-fades + rotates out and the menu content slides in.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the plus-menu-morph transition"

name: reasoning-stream
title: Reasoning stream
description: An agent "thinking out loud" — a small card plays back a stream of reasoning by stepping the transcript up two lines at a time, holding between steps. Soft mask fades at the top and bottom edges sell "more above, more below", and the transcript is cloned once so the loop wraps without a visible jump.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the reasoning-stream transition"

name: shimmer-text
title: Shimmer text
description: A loading / "thinking" label that shimmers — streaming status, "Generating…", any in-progress copy that should feel alive without a spinner. Pure CSS: duplicate the string into `data-text` on `.t-shimmer` and tune `--shimmer-base` / `--shimmer-highlight` per theme.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the shimmer-text transition"

name: skeleton-reveal
title: Skeleton loader and reveal
description: A placeholder that loads then reveals real content — list rows, cards, profile headers. The skeleton pulses, then both layers cross-fade with a matching cross-blur. Bring your own bars / avatar / text; the skeleton stays in the same slot as the content so the swap is layout-free.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the skeleton-reveal transition"

name: spinning-counter
title: Spinning counter
description: Numbers that change with fanfare — points, prices, follower counts, dashboards KPIs. Each digit is a clipped vertical reel of 0-9 cells; the strip translates up through several full spins before landing on the target digit, with a per-column stagger and a vertical-only SVG blur while moving.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the spinning-counter transition"

name: streaming-text
title: Streaming text
description: Model output arriving word by word — chat responses, AI completions, any streamed paragraph. JS wraps each word in a span; words rest visible, and a replay wipes them all, then resolves them in order through opacity plus a small blur, one every `--stream-gap`.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the streaming-text transition"

name: success-check
title: Success check
description: Confirming a completed action — payment processed, file uploaded, message sent, form saved. The icon fades in, rotates upright, settles with a Y-bob, and (for SVG icons) draws its path stroke. Use whenever a status changes from "pending / unknown" to "success" and you want the moment to feel earned rather than instantaneous.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the success-check transition"

name: tabs-sliding
title: Tabs sliding
description: A segmented control / tab bar where the active pill slides between options — view switchers, filter segments, small mutually-exclusive button sets. JS writes the active tab's `offsetLeft` / `offsetWidth` onto the pill; CSS owns the tween.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the tabs-sliding transition"

name: text-states-swap
title: Text states swap
description: Swapping the text of a status indicator in place — "Processing…" → "Done", "Save" → "Saved". The old text exits up with blur, the new text enters from below.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the text-states-swap transition"

name: texts-reveal
title: Texts reveal
description: A headline + supporting line that rise into view with staggered blur — hero copy, empty states, onboarding steps. Exit is decoupled: a single quiet fade with no Y-return so dismissing doesn't replay the reveal in reverse.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the texts-reveal transition"

name: thinking-states
title: Thinking states
description: An AI status line that narrates what the agent is doing — "Setting up a workplace", "Running a command", "Browsing files". The line shimmers while a state holds (the same masked highlight as **shimmer text**), then swaps to the next state with the **text states swap** motion: the old line exits up through a small blur while the new one rises in from below.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the thinking-states transition"

name: toast
title: Toast open / close
description: Toasts, snackbars, and transient confirmations that rise into view from the bottom edge — "Saved", "Copied", "Message sent". The toast translates up with a fade, a slight scale, and a cross-blur; opening runs on the slower open clock while dismissing uses the faster close clock, so arriving feels deliberate and leaving feels snappy.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the toast transition"

name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: On/off switches — settings rows, theme toggles, feature flags. The thumb travels across the track with a two-step overshoot (past the end, back, settle) while the track color cross-fades on its own clock.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the toggle transition"

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip open/close
description: A hover/focus tooltip shared by a group of triggers (toolbar buttons, icon rows, avatar stacks). It fades + scales in with a short appear-delay, disappears immediately on leave, and when the pointer moves to a neighbouring trigger while it is showing, the one bubble tweens its x-position and width to the new target instead of popping a second one. A small JS snippet measures the target and writes the geometry; CSS owns every tween.
install: npx skills add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev  # then ask: "apply the tooltip transition"
